rationale: Planning validation passed for SPRINT-017. The validated decision build is mapped to a sprint and four executable roadmap tasks: TASK-066 architecture diagram YAML migration, TASK-068 system components/flows plus large-doc warning removal, TASK-069 decision row approval TUI and planning-impact preview, and TASK-067 semantic execution closure report. All accepted decision rows and all downstream planning questions are durably resolved in the planning build. Task audits pass for all four tasks, generated parity passes, and bounded wiki_agency dry-run selected TASK-066 with zero writes. Remaining graph warnings are the known large-doc warnings intentionally assigned to TASK-068. Explicit user approval evidence is recorded for the semantic-system/high-risk planning promotion.
